newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar steady, next month's quota down.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar steady, next month's quota down.

text.p: Indian sugar prices were steady on Monday despite low consumer and retail demand, dealers said.
"Supplies were thin as most of the delivery tender out of the free sale quota of the current month are exhausted," one broker said.
He said this month's quota is 800,000 tonnes while next month it is lower at 650,000 tonnes.
In ready delivery sugar S-30 was steady at 1,270/1,325 rupees while M-30 was quiet at 1,300/1,362 rupees. No trading was reported on Monday for sugar mill delivery.
